ideas.title: The $11M Medicaid Fraud Case: Uncovering the Truth
ideas.description: Investigate the $11M Medicaid fraud case in Minnesota, including the entities involved and the methods used to commit the fraud.
questions: What are the implications for Minnesota's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a significant fraud scheme and shed light on the need for improved oversight in Minnesota's healthcare system.

ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's New Office of Inspector General
ideas.description: Analyze the creation of Minnesota's Office of Inspector General and its potential impact on fraud prevention in the state.
questions: How will the Office of Inspector General be structured?
How effective will it be in preventing fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to provide insight into Minnesota's efforts to combat fraud and improve government accountability.
